consent.title: Study Information and Informed Consent
consent.body:
Thank you for taking part in this study!

**What you will do**:  
Create 3 short-video storyboards on given topics, each with a different form of AI assistance, answering a few short questions after each one (about **10-15 minutes** in total).

**Data**:  
We record the text you enter, your interactions, and your questionnaire answers, used **for academic research only** and analyzed anonymously. Nothing that could identify you will be published.

**External AI service**:  
The text you enter (your idea, revision instructions, free-text answers) is sent to the **OpenAI API (United States)** both to **generate** the storyboard and for **analysis** (automatic evaluation and semantic-similarity computation).  
Data sent via the API is not used to train models by default and is deleted after at most 30 days. **Please do not write names, school names, or anything identifying a real person into the idea and storyboard fields.**

**Publication**:  
Your storyboards and the text you write may be quoted, anonymized, in the paper, conference presentations and slides.

**Voluntary participation**:  
Participation is entirely voluntary. You may stop at any time by closing the page, with no negative consequences.

**Contact**:  
g2550005@stu.musashino-u.ac.jp

If you agree, please tick the box below and begin.
consent.agree: I have read the above and agree to take part in this study
consent.no_refresh: ⚠️ Please try not to refresh or use the browser's Back button. If you refresh, the current round has to be redone (scripts you already submitted and earlier rounds are kept). Staying in the same tab resumes automatically where you left off.

intro.title: Before you begin
intro.flow:
This study has 3 rounds. Each round follows this flow:

**Write your idea　→　the AI drafts a script　→ (if needed) tweak it　→　a few short questions**

The way the AI is involved changes a little each round.
intro.freedom: Just put down whatever you already have in mind. A polished mini-script, a rough idea, or just the direction or mood is all fine — write it however you like, as much or as little as you want.
intro.ex_lead: Example: if the topic were "You overslept because your alarm didn't go off" — for the same topic, you can write as much or as little as you like.
intro.ex1_text: ①Close-up of the hero jolting awake in bed; the clock says 9:00. ②Scrambling into clothes and rushing out. ③Running to the station, but the train doors close right in front of them. Comedic, with a touch of wistfulness at the end.
intro.ex2_text: Overslept and running like crazy to make an important appointment.
intro.ex3_text: I want that frantic, hurried feeling — but somehow funny.
intro.ex4_text: A clumsy but lovable protagonist who is really not a morning person.
intro.ex5_text: I want a twist: they rush out of the house in a panic, but today was actually a day off.
intro.ex_note: Just like this, jotting down whatever comes to mind is enough — the AI then creates the storyboard from it. Your actual topic comes up next.
intro.sample_lead: And from the idea you write, the AI ultimately produces a storyboard like this — this is the kind of thing this study makes:
intro.reassure: No filmmaking or scriptwriting experience is needed. There are no right answers — just make what you genuinely want.

screening.title: Background Questionnaire
screening.hint: The following questions are used for analysis only — they do not affect your participation. All single-choice, about 1 minute.
screening.ai_freq: How often do you use generative AI tools such as ChatGPT?
screening.published: Have you ever published short videos you created on platforms such as Douyin, Kuaishou, Bilibili, or TikTok?
screening.background: Do you have a degree or professional experience in film, media, graphic design, or a related field?
screening.written: Have you ever written a storyboard script or screenplay before?
screening.self_rating: How would you rate your own skill at storyboard scriptwriting?
screening.script_confidence: I feel confident I could write a short-video script (storyboard) myself.
screening.aiexp: Have you used AI for any creative task (writing, storyboards, scripts, illustration prompts, etc.)?
screening.trust: I tend to trust that AI-generated content is reasonable
screening.own_trait: I tend to see things I helped create as "mine"
screening.quiz_section: Quick quiz (if you are not sure, choose "I don't know")
screening.quiz1: In filmmaking, what does "close-up" refer to?
screening.quiz1_opt1: Filming the entire scene from a distance
screening.quiz1_opt2: A close-range shot of a person's face or part of an object
screening.quiz1_opt3: A technique in which the camera moves quickly
screening.quiz2_opt1: The color tone and style of the image
screening.quiz2_opt2: How much of the subject is shown within the frame

round.title: Creation Round {i} / {n}
round.instr_C: In this round the AI will generate a complete {shot_count}-shot storyboard script directly from your idea. ⚠️ **It generates only once** — the script cannot be edited or regenerated afterwards, so review it and submit. First, write your story idea (any length or form is fine).
round.instr_D: In this round the AI generates a complete script first; you can then edit it directly, or tell the AI what to change (it can be abstract, e.g. "make it funnier"), and polish it as many times as you like. First, write your story idea (any length or form is fine).
round.instr_E: In this round the AI will first ask you a few questions to understand what you want, then generate the script; afterwards you can keep being guided by the AI or edit the script directly until you are happy. First, write your story idea (any length or form is fine).
round.intent_label: Your story idea (any length or form)
round.intent_placeholder: e.g. The main character (me), at ×× (place), when ××, ×× happens…
round.intent_scope: 🎬 First, picture a short story that fits **{total}s · {count} shots**.

q.title: A few questions about this round
q.hint: Please answer based on the script you just completed.
q.own1: I feel that this storyboard script is MY work.
q.own2: I feel a strong sense of ownership toward this script.
q.own3: This script reflects my own ideas and style.
q.soa1: I was the one who decided the content and direction of this storyboard.
q.soa2: I was able to control the process of making this storyboard myself.
q.tlx1: This round of the task was very mentally demanding.
q.attention: This is an attention check; please select "2".
q.violation: To what extent did the final script go against **your original intent**?
q.shots_hint: For each shot, choose the description that fits best.
q.shot_tag_label: The content of this shot is…
q.whole_tag_label: Overall, the content of this script is…
q.tag_ai_ok: Mostly the AI's, but I approve of it
q.imagine: How close is the final script to **what you pictured at the start**?
q.satisfaction: Overall, I am satisfied with the final result of this round
q.ai_q_quality: The questions the AI asked were on-point and helped me develop my ideas.
q.ai_q_amount: How was the number of questions the AI asked you?
q.ai_q_best: Which of those questions helped you (helped you think it through)?
q.ai_q_best_ph: Select all that apply — or none, if none of them helped.

done.title: All done — thank you for participating! 🎉
done.message: All of your data has been recorded successfully. Here is your completion code:
done.code_use: The completion code is only used if you want to get in touch with the author — in that case, add it to the form below (if you don't, feel free to ignore it).
done.code_hint: Seeing this screen means you are done — you can simply close the page.
done.no_repeat: ⚠️ Please do not take part in this creation study more than once. If you would like a similar service, leave your contact details and what you are after in the form below.
done.contact_title: 🎬 Would you like a real short film?
done.contact_body:
We can turn the storyboard you just wrote into a **real short film**.

- The film is **generated entirely by AI** (visuals, editing and sound alike).
- It is still in development, so it may take **up to a year** to reach your inbox — and it may not arrive at all.
- You are also welcome to leave contact details without asking for the film.

Your email will only be used to send the film or to get in touch — nothing else.
done.contact_want: I would like the short film (I can wait up to a year)
done.contact_note: What you are after / anything to add (optional)
done.contact_note_ph: e.g. make it vertical / I'd like to talk about working together
done.contact_closed: This form is only open in the session that just finished (reloading the page closes it). If you'd like to get in touch, quote the completion code above.
done.contact_saved: ✅ Saved — thank you! We'll email you when there is news.
done.reset_hint: (clears this browser session only — saved database records are kept)

final_survey.title: Finally: looking back
final_survey.hint: Now that you've finished all three rounds, please share your overall impressions.
final_survey.q_pref: Which round's way of creating did you like best?
final_survey.q_reuse: If you use AI to create something in the future, which round's approach would you want to use?
final_survey.q_closest: Which round's result came closest to **what you first pictured**?
final_survey.q_effort: Which round felt like the most effort?
final_survey.q_overall: Overall, how satisfied are you with this creative experience?
final_survey.q_noticed: Did you notice differences between the three rounds?
final_survey.comment: Anything else you'd like to add (optional)
final_survey.q_noticed_opt2: Something felt different, but I can't say what
final_survey.q_noticed_opt3: Yes — how the AI was involved differed (asked first / editable afterwards, etc.)
final_survey.q_noticed_opt4: Yes — I could even guess what this study is comparing

monitor.title: 🗂 Experiment data management · Monitoring
monitor.empty: No participant data yet. Once collection starts, completion progress, Williams-sequence balance, daily progress, and descriptive stats will appear here.
monitor.dup_contact: ⚠️ {n} email address(es) appear on more than one participant row — likely the same person taking part twice (this burns extra seqs and breaks within-subject independence). Addresses are not shown here.
monitor.balance_title: **Condition × topic counts**　(Williams-sequence balance: cells should be roughly equal; greener = more)
monitor.seq_title: **Completed count per seq (condition×topic)**　—— collect until all even (over-recruit absorbs dropouts)
monitor.descriptive_title: **Per-condition subjective means (1-7, descriptive)**　—— rigorous stats (LMM/contrasts/TOST) in 📊 Data analysis below
monitor.lang_mix: Language mix — {mix} (ja = Japan cohort, zh = China cohort — both are study data, analysed separately by language; en means a researcher test or an off-protocol session)
monitor.sessions_hint: A sequence number is claimed at screening and is never reclaimed automatically. Release one only once you are sure the person will not return: the number passes to the next participant, and the row is kept but excluded from analysis.
monitor.release_help: Mark this row as excluded: frees the Latin-square sequence it holds, and the next participant fills that gap. The row is kept but drops out of the analysis. ⚠️ They can still finish if they return with their resume link — check “Last activity” first to be sure they are gone.
monitor.unclosed_warn: {n} of {total} LLM calls started with no terminating event — most likely someone is re-triggering generation (each refresh or click aborts the previous call and fires a new one). Use “Sessions in progress” to find who.
monitor.images_warn: Only {ok} of {total} storyboard illustrations were generated — most likely the image model's per-minute rate limit (failures are swallowed silently and participants see empty frames). Check your OpenAI image rate tier, or stagger participant start times.

analysis.pop_all: Use the full sample (robustness; the primary population is novice)
analysis.err_data: Not enough data, or an error occurred: {err}
